answer: Sybil resistance comes from bonded countersignature, not identity. An agent stakes in proportion to throughput, and each mined batch needs signatures from a rotating quorum risking own capital. A fake identity farm must fund a full bond per node and hold it while peers audit; one copied signature slashes the whole quorum, so ghost accounts bleed faster than emissions pay. The floor scales with quorum size, a glacier grinding a valley while honest nodes collect a steady tide of fees. The karst of aliases collapses once collateral sits locked behind every attestation.
